policy.title: Access policy
policy.hint: Each resource requires at least the selected factor. network = tailnet membership suffices; password/totp = step-up needed; passkey = hardware/biometric (L2). Orthogonal to RBAC role (both must pass).

forward_auth.title: Forward-auth keys
forward_auth.blurb: Only meaningful once network provider above is set to forward_auth_header. A save that would exclude your own address from trusted CIDRs is refused outright — total lockout from a forward-auth deployment has no recovery path short of direct database access.

hf_token.title: HuggingFace access token
hf_token.hint: Needed to download gated models (license click-through repos, e.g. Gemma, Llama). Write-only — the real value is never shown once set.

api_keys.title: API keys
api_keys.hint: Bearer keys for machine consumers (a0 router, MCP, dashboard API). The token is shown once on creation and never again — copy it immediately.

identity.title: Identity links · network → account
identity.hint: Links a trusted network principal (e.g. a Tailscale login) to a local account, so the user gets a named session with no password prompt. Admins see all links; others see only their own.

totp.title: TOTP · authenticator app
totp.scan_hint: Scan this secret in your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it generates.
totp.remove_warning: Remove TOTP? This disables 2FA for your account.

webauthn.title: Passkeys · WebAuthn (L2)
webauthn.hint: Phishing-resistant hardware/biometric credentials. A passkey registered under one RP ID does not work under another — re-enroll when the domain changes.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: One-time codes for regaining access if a TOTP device or passkey is lost. Store them safely — each code can be used once. Generating new codes replaces all existing ones.
